surface_strategies.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-[#2A2A2A] hover:border-[#FF3B30] transition-colors duration-200
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-[#050505] border border-[#2A2A2A] focus:border-[#FF3B30] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF3B30] text-[#F5F5F5]
surface_strategies.buttons_primary: bg-[#F5F5F5] text-[#050505] hover:bg-[#FF3B30] hover:text-[#F5F5F5] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

required_customizations: Remove border-radius from Shadcn components to match Swiss Brutalist look (rounded-none)
Use intense contrast for active states
Inputs and textareas should have explicit focus states with Primary Accent
Tabs should use sharp borders instead of soft pills

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp, fast transitions. Borders change from subtle grey to Primary/Secondary Accent.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use monospace ASCII loaders or sharp pulsing blocks.

marketing_template_thumbnail.description: Sleek futuristic digital interface showcasing technology and precision with vibrant design elements.
marketing_template_thumbnail.usage: Use as thumbnail for the 'Marketing Campaign Dashboard' template

smart_contract_thumbnail.description: Conceptual display of futuristic user interface with percentages and symbols.
smart_contract_thumbnail.usage: Use as thumbnail for the 'Smart Contract Generator' template

data_viz_thumbnail.usage: Use as thumbnail for 'Data Visualization' template

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Grey text must not be too dark.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='send-prompt-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a split-pane layout for the main IDE view: Left side is Chat, Right side is Preview/Code.
The landing page should list templates and previous projects.
Use react-live or iframe injection for the code preview window.
In the Chat interface, include an input at the bottom with a submit button.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout to ensure bento grid spacing. Use Shadcn components heavily customized for the workspace UI (tabs, code editor, chat bubbles).
Apply 'rounded-none' to all containers and buttons to maintain the Swiss aesthetic.
Use Phosphor Icons for the UI elements.
Ensure 'JetBrains Mono' is used for any code-related text or technical metadata.
